description: TerraTrend One is a solo team from Sylhet, Bangladesh, led by a Computer Science and Engineering student. I am participating in the Earth System Trend Detective challenge to explore environmental changes through NASA Earth observation data. My interests include software development, data analysis, statistics, and visualization. My goal is to create an accessible, scientifically meaningful application during the hackathon. I will work and submit independently.
summary: TerraTrend is an interactive web application that helps users investigate long-term changes in Earth's environmental system using NASA POWER monthly point data. Users select a location, an Earth-system indicator, and a study period to view annual time-series charts and estimate linear change per decade. The application reports a two-sided regression significance test and a 95% confidence interval, explains data preparation and limitations, and lets users compare two locations over shared years and export annual values as CSV. It supports air temperature, precipitation, relative humidity, wind speed, and solar irradiance. TerraTrend makes NASA Earth-science data easier to explore and interpret without requiring users to write code.
details:
Project Overview

TerraTrend is an interactive environmental data exploration platform designed to help users investigate long-term changes in Earth's environmental systems using NASA POWER data.

How It Works

Users can select a geographical location, choose an Earth-system indicator, and specify a study period. TerraTrend retrieves historical monthly data from NASA POWER and processes complete monthly records into annual values.

The platform supports five environmental indicators:

  • Air Temperature
  • Precipitation
  • Relative Humidity
  • Wind Speed
  • Solar Irradiance

It visualizes annual data through interactive time-series graphs and applies Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression to estimate long-term trends. Results include estimated change per decade, total fitted change, statistical significance, and 95% confidence intervals.

Key Features and Innovation

Same Planet. Different Signals. is a central feature of TerraTrend. It allows users to compare two geographical locations using the same environmental indicator and study period, helping identify differences in their observed trends.

Other features include:

  • Interactive geographical location selection.
  • NASA POWER data retrieval.
  • Annual environmental trend visualization.
  • Statistical analysis and interpretation.
  • Downloadable CSV datasets.
  • Direct access to original NASA data requests.
  • Explanations of scientific methods and limitations.

Technology and Methodology

TerraTrend is developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with interactive visualizations and statistical calculations implemented within the application. Cloudflare Pages provides public website hosting.

The application uses NASA POWER historical data and applies annual data processing, OLS regression, two-sided statistical testing, and confidence interval calculations.

Intended Impact

TerraTrend aims to make environmental data more accessible and understandable for students, educators, researchers, and the general public. By enabling location-based analysis and regional comparisons, it encourages evidence-based exploration of environmental changes and supports greater awareness of Earth's changing systems.

Scientific Considerations

NASA POWER provides gridded Earth-science estimates rather than direct measurements from weather stations at every selected coordinate. Statistical significance does not establish causation. Results should be interpreted with consideration of data sources, geographical context, and statistical limitations.
